summary: This document is a commercial service brief for "Bounty Radar," a blockchain/crypto verification service that checks USDC escrow transactions on the Base network. It describes a methodology for verifying on-chain payment evidence (ERC-20 Transfer events, gas costs, block pinning, escrow liquidity). There is no biotech, scientific, or therapeutic content whatsoever.

content_blocks.title: Bounty Radar – Payout Evidence Brief (Commercial Service)
content_blocks.content: This document describes a paid service for verifying cryptocurrency (USDC on Base blockchain) escrow transactions. It outlines a methodology for checking ERC-20 Transfer events, gas costs, block pinning, and escrow withdrawal paths. Pricing is listed at $0.50–$1.00 per report, settled in USDC on Base. There is no scientific, biotech, or therapeutic content. This document is entirely irrelevant to TRL assessment.
